method.coordinates: Use t=(a-a_left)/a_left for a single cell, retaining exact rational a. y=(phi,X). In u=ln(a), y'=(X/H,-3X-U_phi/H), with H²=B0+(X²/2+U+f)/3. Divide the field by 1+t for t.
method.center: Start a degree-12 reference polynomial P at the exact midpoint of the two stored intervals. Coefficients are exact representations of selected numerical values. A polynomial is a reference curve, and every truncation and rounding error enters the validated defect.
method.tube_and_defect: Certify a convex state box B containing the true trajectory by whole-cell Picard inclusion and containing P([0,h]). Certify H²>0 and the literal EDE guard over the whole cell. Use outward Taylor algebra with rigorous remainder to bound each component of F(t,P(t))-P'(t), preserving cancellation in the polynomial coefficients. Bound the absolute defect by r_i.
method.comparison: On [0,h]×B bound J=∂_yF. Take constant M_ii≥sup J_ii, M_ij≥sup|J_ij| (i≠j), with exact/outward bounds. Do not replace a proven negative diagonal by its absolute value. From the initial componentwise radii, enclose w'=Mw+r and use |y-P|≤w. Use a positive shift of the augmented Metzler matrix and a certified exponential series/tail with directed rounding, or an equivalent separately justified enclosure of the same comparison. Intersect the endpoint box with B only after proving both inclusions. An empty intersection is a defect.
method.independent_trigonometric_enclosure: Use directed rational interval evaluation. For each whole argument interval, retain a valid coarse enclosure and intersect with the universal range. When a certified sign of the derivative establishes monotonicity, enclose the range from outward endpoint evaluations. For f=sin or cos, f″=-f: when f>0 is certified throughout, use the minimum of endpoint lower bounds and upper bound 1; when f<0 is certified throughout, use lower bound -1 and the maximum of endpoint upper bounds. Intersect all justified enclosures. For remaining intervals keep the valid coarse bound, subdivide with a covering union, or use certified range reduction and critical-point inclusion. Uncertain signs never establish monotonicity. Respect the evaluator argument domain and use the same sound cosine enclosure for independent endpoint energy, including when monotonicity cannot be certified.
method.first_cell: From the exact V103 checkpoint regenerate the stored failed proposal at its exact a1 if within the existing limits. Run every acceptance gate including fresh defect computation, independent checks and exact connection. A diagnostic pass on stored data does not grant acceptance. If inclusion remains unresolved, stop and record the precise witness. Ordinary producer rejections may halve under the existing retry cap.
